security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Scan a computer for problems, in plain language.
bundle.longDescription: An AI-assisted diagnostic and repair tool. It scans for hardware and software problems, explains what it found in plain language, and can attempt fixes with a snapshot taken first and a rollback on failure.
